studies.title: Butyrate supplementation reduces sarcopenia by repairing neuromuscular junction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
studies.reading_depth: Full discovery abstract and partial indexed primary main/captions; native figures/full tables unavailable.

population.site: Gomal Medical College, Dera Ismail Khan, Pakistan

functional_results.chair_stand: No improvement in butyrate; placebo score declined. Difference of significance does not prove prevented decline.
functional_results.reported_between_arm_test: None recovered; primary statistical section and outcome captions specify paired baseline comparisons.
functional_results.effect_size_extraction: No graph digitization or new statistical calculation.

other_results.associations: HGS/gait/SPPB and selected plasma markers; not mediation

analysis.reported_tests: paired t-tests within each group, Pearson associations; GraphPad Prism8; nominalP<.05
analysis.intention_to_treat: not established; final sample excludes20 randomized participants

studies.safety: Systematic adverse-event assessment and attrition reasons not recovered. Discussion says no malabsorption/GI upset; not a full safety result.
studies.mechanism_limit: Biomarker shifts/associations do not demonstrate repaired NMJ, causal gut-muscle mediation, bacterial clearance or sepsis treatment. Plasma butyrate unmeasured; diet and medication effects not investigated.
studies.qualification: Retain preparation-specific compensation signal with unresolved randomized between-arm effect and partial source access; no MVA efficacy/superiority/restoration claim.

shared_interpretation.function_credit: Measured within-arm functional observations retained. Randomization alone does not convert their tests into between-arm evidence.
shared_interpretation.mechanistic_boundary: No causal NMJ repair or BUBR1 restoration established. BUBR1 mediation required for restoration, not compensation eligibility.
shared_interpretation.competitiveness: No demonstrated MVA benefit or superiority to provisional niacin/apitegromab; same function, exposure, durability/renewal and fidelity criteria.
shared_interpretation.renewal_durability_fidelity: No muscle-renewal, post-withdrawal durability or chromosome-fidelity endpoint established.
shared_interpretation.replication: Shared investigators/institutions; different interventions, not independent-lab replication or combination/synergy proof.
